sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-288.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 288 was established by Ordinance No. 19858, passed by the Dallas City Council on February 10, 1988. Ordinance No. 19858 amended Ordinance Nos. 10962 and 19455, Chapters 51 and 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19455; 19858; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-288.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 288 is established on property generally located southeast of Pennsylvania Avenue and northeast of Second Avenue. The size of PD 288 is approximately 11.998 acres. (Ord. Nos. 19858; 25711)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-288.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-288.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 288A). (Ord. Nos. 19858; 25711)

sections.title: Use
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-288.105. USE.

Use of the Property is limited to a public park, playground, or golf course use. The primary facility on the Property must be an amphitheater for performing arts. For the purposes of this article, an amphitheater for performing arts means a facility for entertainment, recreational, cultural, and social gatherings, and includes other uses incidental to the operation of the amphitheater that are normally associated with and customarily available in similar entertainment or amusement facilities. Permitted incidental uses include but are not limited to: souvenir, gift, and novelty shops, a box office, food and chair-rental concessions, a first aid-security station or office, administrative offices, a commissary, and a broadcast transmitting station. (Ord. Nos. 19858; 25711)

sections.title: Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-288.106. LANDSCAPE PLAN.

Landscaping must be provided as shown on the landscape plan (Exhibit 288B). Landscaping must be installed within six months of the date of issuance of a certificate of occupancy for any use on the Property. All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 19858; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Seating Capacity
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-288.107. MAXIMUM SEATING CAPACITY.

No more than 20,000 seats are permitted in the amphitheater. (Ord. Nos. 19858; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Floor Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-288.108. MAXIMUM FLOOR AREA.

No more than 107,000 square feet of floor area are permitted on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 19858; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-288.109. MAXIMUM HEIGHT.

Maximum height of the stage and covered seating structure shown on the development plan is 65 feet. Maximum height of all other structures is 36 feet. (Ord. Nos. 19858; 25711)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-288.110. PARKING.

The off-street parking requirement for the amphitheater use is 6,000 spaces. Charging a fee for required parking is expressly permitted. (Ord. Nos. 19858; 25711)

sections.title: Permissible Noise Levels
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-288.111. PERMISSIBLE NOISE LEVELS.

(a) The noise regulations contained in Section 51A-6.102 apply to all uses on the Property except insofar as they are expressly modified by this article.

(b) The maximum permissible decibel limits contained in Section 51A-6.102(d) do not apply to the Property and are replaced by the following restrictions on average sound pressure levels. The maximum permissible average sound pressure level on any day, as measured on the A scale over a 30- minute-period at the residential bounding property line described in Subsection (c), may not exceed the following decibel limits during the following time periods:

Maximum Permitted Time Period Decibel Limit

From 7 a.m. until 11:30 p.m. 65

From 11:30 p.m. until 7 a.m. 58

(c) The residential bounding property line for purposes of Subsection (b) is the southeast right-of-way line of Fitzhugh Avenue; the southwest, west, and northwest right-of-way line of Robert B. Cullum Boulevard; and the northeast boundary line of the T & P Railroad right-of-way. This line is shown on the map provided as Exhibit 288C.

(d) Noises associated with the operation of the amphitheater use that do not exceed the maximum decibel limits in Subsection (b) may not be construed as “loud and raucous” noises within the meaning of Chapter 30 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and other noise regulations applicable to the city generally, including but not limited to those contained in Section 51A-6.102 and in Chapter 30 of the Dallas City Code, as amended, the provisions of this article control. (Ord. Nos. 19858; 25711)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-288.112. SIGNS.

Signs erected on the Property must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 19858; 25711)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-288.113. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Use of the Property must comply with the requirements of all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19858; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-288.114. ZONING MAP.

PD 288 is located on Zoning Map Nos. J-8 and K-8. (Ord. Nos. 19858; 25711)
